feeds.title: Northwest Wine Report
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Sean P. Sullivan, Washington Wine Report is an online publication dedicated to the wines and wineries of the Pacific Northwest, aiming to bring Northwest wine to you and bring you to Northwest wine. My goal is to help you select Northwest wines at a variety of price levels; to keep you up-to-date about the area's wineries, vineyards, and individuals.

feeds.title: Owen Bargreen Blog
feeds.description: Dr. Owen Bargreen is the founder/executive editor of OwenBargreen.com, formerly Washington Wine Blog. He has been writing about wine for more than ten years and has reviewed thousands of wines from around the world. Owen has also traveled extensively in Washington, Oregon, and California, as well as throughout wine regions of the world, including the Bordeaux and the Rhone valley in France, Spain, Germany, and Italy.

feeds.title: Lines On Wines Blog
feeds.description: Marji Morgan talks with winemakers about the history and stories behind our wonderful Washington wines. We offer a wealth of information on unique and award-winning Washington wines, the wine-making process, and how the guts, dedication, and amazing creativity of our Washington winemakers and grape growers turned high desert lands full of sagebrush and rattlesnakes into world-class vineyards.

feeds.title: Great Northwest Wine » Washington Wine
feeds.description: This section of our blog features articles that have to do exclusively with the Washington Wines. We have been writing stories about wines for the last 20 years to help you get the inside scoop on what's happening in our region of the world. We also review the latest wines from the Pacific Northwest.

feeds.title: VinoSocial Wine Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Nancy Croisier. Welcome to VinoSocial, where we're working to connect wine drinkers with the people and places behind the bottles. Social media is our specialty. We'll create a strategy to tell your story and reach the right people. Wine marketing is our area of expertise.

feeds.title: Lake Chelan Wine Blog
feeds.description: Chic wine tasting adventures in the Lake Chelan wine valley. We're passionate about Washington wines. We'll share our adventures tasting wine, visiting tasting rooms, and meeting winemakers in the Lake Chelan wine valley.

feeds.title: Discover Washington Wine Blog
feeds.description: Discover Washington Wine Blog and Featured Stories are written to share the best of Washington State's wine industry, its people, wineries, vineyards, and tasting rooms with the world. We are an On-Line Magazine whose sole purpose is to help the world discover why Washington Wine is among the world's best, achieving high scores on a regular basis in wine competitions throughout the U.S.

feeds.title: Pacific Northwest Wine Life & Style
feeds.description: Find your next favorite winery tasting room in Woodinville. Discover new wines, and new restaurants to eat at during your wine adventures! Jen is a professional photographer from Snoqualmie Ridge. Carrie is a writer and researcher from Woodinville. We share our chic and delightful wine tasting adventures and help you find your new favorite wine tasting room!

feeds.title: Wine Snob Blog » Washington
feeds.description: In the following section of Washington, we have reviewed a plethora of Washington Wines. Our experts share articles about different types of wines, such as different ages of red, white wines, and more. We publish independent wine reviews and provide a closer look at what lies under the cork.
